description.en: Paraceratherium; P. grangeri reference convention: whole living hornless giant rhino environment prop. Nominal whole length 1.2m. All proportions, soft tissues, ears, lip, feet, pose and warm grey colour are art settings. Museum whole silhouette/head art is reference, not exact specimen reconstruction. Li2022 Figure1 Dzungariotherium excluded. No exact skeleton, maximum mass, species-exclusive measurement or animation claim.
